item.title: Pair of Chinese giant pandas arrives in US city Atlanta
item.description:
Published: 2026-09-27
Pair of Chinese giant pandas arrives in US city Atlanta Share - WeChat
ATLANTA - A chartered FedEx cargo plane carrying a pair of Chinese giant pandas, Ping Ping and Fu Shuang, landed in Atlanta in the southeastern United States on Sunday morning. The two giant pandas are expected to stay at Zoo Atlanta for 10 years, according to an agreement between Zoo Atlanta and the China Wildlife Conservation Association.

item.title: China, US reach consensus on eight outcomes in Xi's visit
item.description:
Published: 2026-09-26
China, US reach consensus on eight outcomes in Xi's visit WASHINGTON -- President Xi Jinping and his US counterpart, Donald Trump, have reached a consensus on eight outcomes, according to a release made public after Xi wrapped up his US visit on Friday. The two leaders have agreed to build a constructive China-US relationship of strategic stability based on respect, fairness and reciprocity, said the release. They also agreed to support each other as China will host the 2026 APEC Economic Leaders' Meeting in November and the United States will host the G20 Leaders' Summit in December, expressing intention that they will attend each other's event. On Iran, Xi and Trump have agreed that Tehran should fulfill its commitment not to develop nuclear weapons. No country or institution shall charge transit fees for passage through international waterways, they said. Xi paid a state visit to the United States from Wednesday to Friday, during which he had an in-depth exchange of views with Trump on bilateral relations as well as major international and regional issues. The release noted that the two leaders recalled that China and the United States were allies during World War II, and fought side by side to win the war. Ahead of Xi's state visit, Chinese and US economic and trade teams concluded their latest round of consultation in New York. The two leaders acknowledged the positive role of the China-US economic and trade consultation mechanism, and recognized the outcomes achieved by their respective economic and trade teams, namely the establishment and advancement of such mechanisms as a trade council, a $30 billion reciprocal tariff reduction arrangement, and an extension of what have been achieved in the Kuala Lumpur consultation. They instructed that those outcomes be implemented. On bilateral counternarcotics law enforcement cooperation, Xi and Trump commended the tangible results. The release said recently, the two sides have worked closely to jointly crack multiple cases involving new psychoactive substances and precursor chemicals, and arrest dozens of suspects in both countries. As to artificial intelligence (AI), they agreed to establish China-US AI dialogue to exchange views on AI-related risks and benefits, with the next round to be held in November. A communication channel for AI-related incidents will also be set up. The US side welcomes the upcoming arrival of two giant pandas leased by China to Zoo Atlanta, according to the release. In addition to the eight outcomes, the Chinese and US militaries agreed to sign a memorandum of understanding as soon as possible on strengthening crisis communication and prevention. The two militaries will continue cooperation on searching for the remains of US soldiers in China, said the release.

item.title: Veteran Chinese musician Liu Huan dies at 63
item.description:
Published: 2026-09-26
Veteran Chinese musician Liu Huan dies at 63 Chinese musician Liu Huan, whose powerful voice and wide-ranging work made him one of the country's best-known singers, died in Shanghai on Sept 25. He was 63. Liu passed away at 9:52 am surrounded by family members, according to obituaries issued on Saturday by the University of International Business and Economics, where he taught for more than three decades, and the Mango V Foundation, with which he established a charity supporting young original musicians. Born in Tianjin in August 1963, Liu studied French literature at the University of International Relations in Beijing. He first attracted attention in 1985, when he stood out in singing competitions in English and French among students from Beijing universities. He went on to become a prominent singer, composer and music educator, with songs including Young Ambition Knows No Sorrow, The Curved Moon, Asking Myself A Thousand Times and Heroes' Song becoming widely known in China. His international profile grew further in 2008, when he and British soprano Sarah Brightman performed You and Me, the official theme song of the Beijing Olympic Games, at the opening ceremony. Liu also became widely recognized as a mentor to younger musicians. In 2014, he initiated and served as a mentor on Sing My Song, an original-music competition program that sought to promote Chinese-language songwriting. Music education remained a major part of his career. Liu joined the University of International Business and Economics in Beijing in July 1991 as a teacher in its art education program, later rising to associate professor before retiring in September 2023. He taught Western music history, a popular course that drew large numbers of students, and he also composed the university's anthem. In 2019, Liu donated 20 million yuan ($2.8 million) to establish the Liu Huan Original Music Fund with the Mango V Foundation, committing 1 million yuan annually to support young Chinese-language musicians. The university described Liu as a musician who combined music education, composition and singing, and said his death was a major loss to both the university and China's music community. According to the obituaries, Liu had requested that his funeral arrangements be kept simple. No funeral committee, farewell ceremony or memorial service will be held. The Mango V Foundation said it would continue the annual original-music charity fund in accordance with Liu's wishes.

item.title: Economist: Stability in China-US ties breeds prosperity
item.description:
Published: 2026-09-26
Economist Chen Wenling: Stability in China-US ties breeds prosperity Share - WeChat
"When China-US relations are stable, the world is stable. When China and the US live in harmony, the world prospers," Chen Wenling, an economist, said in a recent interview with China Daily. She added that, as two major economies shaping the global landscape, China and the US have different development paths and political systems, yet share significant responsibilities for the world. "The two countries need to follow the consensus reached by their leaders and genuinely work toward building a constructive and strategically stable relationship," she said. Production and supply grew steadily, employment and prices were generally stable, foreign trade saw rapid growth, and new growth drivers played a stronger role.
